$comment: Skill Hub M1 seed import list (CONTENT-003 / CONTENT-004). Human-readable companion doc: docs/plans/mvp/content/curated-skill-list.md. JSON has no comments, so the field contract lives in the `schema` object below. Nothing here is a decision: `tier` is a proposal until CONTENT-005/006/007/008 close out, and no work item is checked. 2026-08-26: check 7 was flipped to pass for all 45 to match the doc, which has recorded it as pass since 2026-08-16 (45/45 automated review, m1/content-review-report.md). The doc and this file had disagreed for ten days, and CONTENT-003's tick condition is check 5 AND check 7 while CONTENT-003 also declares THIS file authoritative on conflict -- so the disagreement did not read as a disagreement, it read as check 7 still being pending. The `checks` object is not consumed by any importer; it is a record, which is exactly why nothing caught it. 2026-08-27: checks 4 and 5 recorded for the 15 curated entries from a line-by-line review of the pinned bytes (docs/plans/mvp/content/report-curated-checks-4-5.md). script_lines was wrong for TEN of the fifteen - it counted embedded blocks OR script files, never both - and the largest error was an under-count on the one entry that turns out to exceed the ceiling. That entry, data-analyst, keeps check 4 as pass: 2026-08-27 02:497 was amended so 300 lines is a review TRIGGER, not an admission bar - over 300 the line-by-line review must land in a named document and be linked from the curated list, which it did. The three prohibitions did not move. 2026-08-28: check 8 was flipped to pass for the fifteen curated entries, and this is the same accident as check 7 above, one file over. The check is "at least one baseline sandbox run passed"; CONTENT-007 and CONTENT-008 both closed on 2026-08-16 with 精選 15/15 判定「符合」 (succeeded + skill_activation in trace + an artifact), recorded per skill in m2/content-baseline-report.md §4 and §10, and re-measured on image 2026.08-3 in §14 (the four skipped there are license-restricted and all sit in the indexed tier, so every curated entry was covered by both rounds). The record sat pending for twelve days while the work that cleared it was ticked in another file. It matters more than check 7 did: 02:CONTENT-001 says any check still `pending` forbids the 精選 mark, and CONTENT-003 makes THIS file authoritative on conflict, so by the authoritative record none of the fifteen was eligible - for a stale field, not a failed check. Nothing here re-decides anything; it copies a result that already exists. The indexed thirty keep check 8 pending, correctly: 9 of them were cut off by the budget counter and were never curated.

schema.sources: Map of source_id -> repository record. Skills reference a source by key so repo metadata is stored once. An importer must join skills[].source_id against this map.
schema.sources.<id>.url: Canonical repository URL. Content MUST be fetched from here, never from an awesome-list or marketplace page (PDM-002 backtracking admission rule).
schema.sources.<id>.commit: Full 40-char commit SHA observed at verified_at. This is the pin: import MUST fetch this SHA, not the branch head (INGEST-004 / curation check 2).
schema.sources.<id>.default_branch: Branch the commit was observed on.
schema.sources.<id>.license: SPDX id, or 'LicenseRef-Anthropic-Source-Available' for Anthropic's per-skill terms. Determined by reading the actual LICENSE file, NOT README claims or GitHub metadata.
schema.sources.<id>.license_file: Path of the license file that was actually read. Note case-sensitivity: iamursky/sokrati ships a lowercase 'license'.
schema.sources.<id>.license_scope: 'repo' = one license covers everything; 'per_skill_directory' = each skill dir carries its own license and repo-level metadata is null (anthropics/skills).
schema.sources.<id>.redistributable: true = Download Artifact may be produced (02:PACK-001). false = index and in-platform trial runs only, no artifact.
schema.sources.<id>.source_available: true marks a source-available (non-OSI) license. Per PDM-002 these never produce a Download Artifact.
schema.sources.<id>.derivation: Provenance / derivative-relationship note for 02:DISC-003 and CONTENT-002. 'original' means the author's own work.
schema.sources.<id>.author: Identifiable author or org (curation check 9), used by CONTENT-009 takedown and change notification.
schema.sources.<id>.stars: Stargazer count at verified_at. Recorded for upstream-disappearance risk, NOT for ranking (02:DISC-002 forbids star-only sorting).
schema.skills[].name: Skill name as it appears in the SKILL.md frontmatter / directory name.
schema.skills[].skill_md_path: Path to SKILL.md relative to the repo root, at the pinned commit.
schema.skills[].category: One of documents | writing | data (PDM-001). Boundary rule: create/format = documents, tidy/filter/dedupe/merge/split/replace = data.
schema.skills[].tier: 'curated' or 'indexed'. PROPOSED value. Promotion to curated requires all nine PDM-002 checks to pass; see `checks`. NOTE the counting convention: tier is exclusive (a skill is one or the other), but PDM-002's 8-12 indexed target is inclusive of curated, so indexed_total = count(curated) + count(indexed). targets.actual reports the inclusive totals.
schema.skills[].deps: Third-party runtime packages the skill needs, as PyPI/npm distribution names. This is a record of what the PACKAGE says, not of what the Runtime Image provides: it MUST cover every third-party module the package's scripts import AND every package named on a `pip install` line in its SKILL.md, including ones marked optional. Verifiable by static scan, and re-derived that way on 2026-08-16 after the M2 baseline found 13 skills short (content-baseline-report.md section 13.4) - the original values were transcribed from an incomplete read and the Runtime Image, which installs the union of this field, inherited the gap. An entry here is NOT a promise the image carries it: installation is gated separately by the admission bar in infra/images/README.md, and rejected entries are named there. Empty array = prompt-only with no declared dependency.
schema.skills[].network: true if the skill needs egress. Any true value fails curation check 6 under ADR-005 default-deny; such skills are not in this file.
schema.skills[].script_lines: Measured or estimated executable script size, including code embedded in SKILL.md. null = not measured. Curation check 4 caps this at 300.
schema.skills[].checks: Per-skill result of the nine PDM-002 curation checks, keyed '1'..'9': pass | fail | pending. 'pending' means it cannot be decided before a later work item runs; see checks_pending_owner. Check 6 ('no egress/MCP, dependencies present in the Runtime Image') carries a 2026-08-16 correction: the original pass values were recorded against the under-transcribed `deps` field above, so 13 skills were compared against a list that omitted what they actually needed - a verdict with no input rather than a wrong verdict. Against correctly derived deps they should have read fail on image 2026.08-2. The values here stay pass because they are re-derived, on 2026.08-3, under the criterion the correction also makes explicit: PASS IFF no egress and every declared dependency is either installed in the image OR named in that image's published rejection list - a disclosed gap passes, an unknown gap does not. Both inputs are machine-produced: skillpkg's `package-dependencies` finding and the admit/reject tables in infra/images/README.md. Full record: docs/plans/mvp/content/curated-skill-list.md section 3 footnote 7.
schema.skills[].excluded_files: Optional. Package files proven NOT to sit on any SKILL.md-mandated path, so an importer may drop them without changing what the skill does. Present only where exclusion was actually adjudicated.
schema.skills[].non_excludable_files: Optional. Package files that SKILL.md mandates as pipeline steps or quality gates. If any of these fails a curation check the skill cannot be curated, because dropping them would rewrite the skill's semantics.
schema.skills[].notes: Free text. Anything an importer or reviewer must not miss.

targets.$comment: PDM-002 first-batch volume targets and what this file actually delivers.

checks_pending_owner.8: Resolved for the curated fifteen on 2026-08-28 (CONTENT-007/008, both ticked 2026-08-16). Still pending for the indexed thirty, which were never taken through curation: of those, 20 met the baseline, 9 were stopped by the platform's own gateway budget counter and 1 produced nothing. Owner for those remains CONTENT-007 then CONTENT-008.

anthropic.author: anthropics
anthropic.notes: Repo-level license metadata is null. Each skill dir carries its own LICENSE.txt and MUST be judged individually - doc-coauthoring has none at all. README carries a blanket 'demonstration and educational purposes only' disclaimer that CONTENT-005 wording has to account for.

anthropic-sa.author: anthropics
anthropic-sa.notes: BLOCKER PENDING LEGAL. The terms forbid not only distribution but also 'extracting, copying, creating derivative works, or reproducing the materials outside the Services'. That wording may also cover Skill Hub storing a content snapshot, which INGEST-004 requires. If legal reads it that way, these four drop from 'indexed' to external-link-only and documents falls to 6 indexed, below the 8-12 floor. See curated-skill-list.md section 5.2. Never produce a Download Artifact from these.

yuyy-excel.author: YuYY2004
yuyy-excel.notes: 18 skills at claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (a parallel codex/ edition merges everything into one CODEX.md - do not import that). requirements.txt pins lxml>=5.0.0, pandas>=2.0.0, openpyxl>=3.1.0; lxml entered the PDM-004 whitelist on 2026-08-14. Single author, 2 stars: highest upstream-disappearance risk in this file. SKILL.md text is Simplified Chinese.

wrangler.author: danielrosehill (Daniel Rosehill)
wrangler.notes: 32 skill dirs observed on 2026-08-15. NEVER import the whole repo: hf-dataset-push, vector-upsert, sql-load, api-loader, graph-database, database-guide, enrich-with-currency all need egress, and data-to-document needs the Typst CLI. Only the skills listed below are cleared.

nqumich.author: nqumich
nqumich.notes: 1 star, last push 2026-03-02. Cleanest dependency profile in the data category but the weakest survival odds - a good CONTENT-009 takedown-drill target.

humanizer.derivation: original; methodology cites Wikipedia 'Signs of AI writing' (CC BY-SA 4.0) as a reference, not as copied code - CONTENT-005 should surface the citation
humanizer.author: blader
humanizer.notes: Highest-star curated pick across all three categories. SKILL.md frontmatter self-declares license: MIT, consistent with the LICENSE file. scripts/validate-package.py (1952 bytes) is packaging validation, not an execution path.

neon-jetpack.author: cabbagecachekid
neon-jetpack.notes: Prompt-only repo (skills/ and docs/ only, no scripts anywhere). Skills ux-web-design-review and journey-map are design review, not writing - excluded. using-neon-jetpack is meta - excluded.

sokrati.author: iamursky (Ilya Evseev)
sokrati.notes: License file is lowercase 'license' - the importer's license detection must be case-insensitive. The repo ships one capability in 7 language variants (abbrevia/abrege/abrevia/escurca/kuerzen/shorten/sokrati); only 2 are seeded, deliberately, so PDM-011 recall@5 is not swamped by near-duplicates.

handoff.author: ToolMonsters
handoff.notes: Root-level SKILL.md, zero dependencies, no scripts.

kagura-docfmt.author: KaguraNanaga
kagura-docfmt.notes: Root-level SKILL.md plus 9 scripts under scripts/. process.py alone is ~290 lines, so total is well over the 300-line curation cap - indexed only. Optional pywin32 (.doc/.wps conversion) is Windows-only and outside the whitelist; that path is unavailable in the Runtime Image, the core .docx path needs only python-docx.

quiz-builder.derivation: repo bundles docs/superpowers/, apparently referencing obra/superpowers (MIT, license-compatible); CONTENT-006 should confirm attribution is complete
quiz-builder.author: the3ma
quiz-builder.notes: Node.js, zero npm dependencies (node: builtins only), Node >= 18 which the Node 22 image satisfies. Core flow is offline BUT publish-pages.mjs needs GitHub Pages and browser-check.mjs needs Chromium - import must confirm both can be excluded or check 6 fails. .mjs line counts not measured.

skills.name: excel-insert
skills.notes: Insert rows/columns = creation, so documents rather than data under the PDM-001 boundary rule. SKILL.md is ~280-300 lines total with ~180 lines of embedded Python; no pip install text.

skills.name: excel-freeze
skills.notes: Freeze/unfreeze panes = formatting, so documents. Smallest script footprint of the excel-* family.

skills.name: handoff
skills.notes: Produces a portable markdown handoff document. Prompt-only, ~180 lines of instructions, zero dependencies - the lowest-risk documents pick.

skills.name: excel-format
skills.notes: Promoted to curated 2026-08-15 as the 4th documents pick. The earlier '~1600-1800 lines, check 4 fails' record was a MEASUREMENT ERROR: at the pinned commit SKILL.md is 262 lines / 9839 bytes / sha256 68dc7ce82d6b14bb967e691356c30fe148624cb011ecd7b7f67287c0f8ff85e0, with 168 lines of embedded Python - verified byte-identical via the codeload zip and raw.githubusercontent.com. No eval/exec, no dynamic download, no subprocess, no pip install text. pandas+numpy are used only on the COL_WIDTH='auto' branch; all three deps are in the PDM-004 whitelist. Check 4 stays pending only for the line-by-line human review (CONTENT-006), same convention as excel-insert/excel-freeze. SKILL.md wiki-links [[excel-safe-workflow]], a sibling skill not shipped inside the package; import raised no blocking error. Simplified Chinese - CONTENT-005 must rewrite the summary in zh-Hant. See curated-skill-list.md section 9.1.

skills.name: document-format-skills
skills.notes: Check 4 fails on aggregate script size (9 files, process.py alone ~290 lines). Chinese official-document formatting (GB/T 9704-2012).

skills.name: course-quiz-builder
skills.notes: Measured 2026-08-15; curated promotion REJECTED, stays indexed. Lines in skills/course-quiz-builder/scripts/: build-quiz.mjs 266, browser-check.mjs 257, selftest.mjs 341, publish-selftest.mjs 356, publish-pages.mjs 768 (1988 total). Check 4 FAILS: three files exceed the 300-line cap, and selftest.mjs uses new Function() to evaluate the template CORE region, which is eval-equivalent and explicitly barred. Check 6 FAILS: publish-pages.mjs is Pipeline step 7 in SKILL.md ('Skip only if the user asked for a local page') and needs GitHub API egress via fetch(), execFileSync of git and 'gh auth token', and a repo-write token - it is NOT excludable, and selftest.mjs is likewise mandatory under hard rule 2 ('Never ship without selftest.mjs printing PASS'). Only browser-check.mjs is excludable: SKILL.md marks it 'Optionally' and it skips cleanly when no browser is present. Its token resolution chain and exit-4 secret guard make it a SEC-005 / NFR-002 sample of interest. See curated-skill-list.md section 9.2.

skills.name: docx
skills.notes: Check 1 fails - source-available, not redistributable. No Download Artifact ever. Indexing itself is pending legal review, see sources.anthropic-sa.

skills.name: pdf
skills.notes: Same source-available constraint as docx. Its scripts import a rendering and OCR stack the Runtime Image rejects at the admission bar (reportlab, pypdfium2, pdf2image which also needs the poppler binaries, pytesseract which also needs tesseract-ocr; reasons in infra/images/README.md dependency-set section), so the form-filling, page-rasterising and scanned-PDF paths cannot run here. The read/extract/merge path over pypdf + pdfplumber + pillow does run and is what produced the passing 2026-08-16 baseline (content-baseline-report.md section 13.2). SKILL.md also offers a Node path (pdf-lib, pdfjs-dist); the image preinstalls no third-party npm packages, so that one is unavailable too.

skills.name: xlsx
skills.notes: Classified documents (create/format), not data, per the PDM-001 boundary rule. Same source-available constraint as docx.

skills.name: brand-guidelines
skills.notes: Apache-2.0 confirmed by reading skills/brand-guidelines/LICENSE.txt on 2026-08-15. EVAL-001 requires a per-skill editable rubric for writing skills - CONTENT-007.

skills.name: internal-comms
skills.notes: Apache-2.0. Same rubric requirement as brand-guidelines.

skills.name: humanizer
skills.notes: Removes AI-writing tells. Self-contained, no runtime scripts on the execution path; check 4 pending only because scripts/validate-package.py has not been read line by line.

skills.name: line-edit
skills.notes: Sentence-level polish without changing meaning. Frontmatter read on 2026-08-15: no network, no APIs, no MCP, no packages.

skills.name: ai-written-check
skills.notes: Checklist-based detection of mechanical AI tells. Overlaps humanizer in intent but differs in output (audit vs rewrite) - keep both, they make a useful comparison pair for 02:DISC-004.

skills.name: cringe-check
skills.notes: Indexed tier does not require the nine checks; per-skill SKILL.md not individually read, repo-level facts (MIT, prompt-only, no scripts) apply.

skills.name: copyright-creative-work
skills.notes: Copyright basics, NOT legal advice. UI wording must follow the NFR-001 discipline (no 'safe', no 'official recommendation') and add a not-legal-advice qualifier.

skills.name: shorten
skills.notes: English variant only. The 5 other language variants (abbrevia, abrege, abrevia, escurca, kuerzen) are deliberately NOT seeded - near-duplicate semantics would blunt PDM-011 recall@5.

skills.name: data-analyst
skills.notes: scripts/data_ops.py, 203 lines, CSV/TSV/XLSX/JSON/JSONL. Zero dependency gaps. SKILL.md is Simplified Chinese - CONTENT-005 must rewrite the summary in Traditional Chinese.

skills.name: csv-to-json
skills.notes: Output supports schema assertions - the highest acceptance-certainty candidate, best first target for CONTENT-007.

skills.name: excel-deduplicate
skills.notes: Directly matches the PDM-001 canonical task sentence 'drop the duplicate rows'. lxml is whitelisted as of 2026-08-14 so this is unconditional now. WATCH: the dependency section of SKILL.md contains 'pip install' text - all three packages are preinstalled so the branch is inert, but the wording tells the model to do something the runtime forbids, same shape as the M0 rejection of cabbage2000-lab/data-analysis-skills. CONTENT-006 must confirm or annotate.

skills.name: excel-delete
skills.notes: M0-verified candidate. SKILL.md instructs `from compact_rows import compact_xlsx`, and the package ships no compact_rows module - the scan raises undeclared-dependency on it. It is not a PyPI package and must not enter `deps`; it is a cross-skill reference to a sibling in the same repo (02:CONTENT-006 "cross-Skill reference to a file outside the package"), unresolved at the pinned commit.

skills.name: pii-flag
skills.notes: M0-verified candidate. UI wording must not imply this is a compliance guarantee (NFR-001 discipline). SKILL.md's install line names presidio-analyzer/presidio-anonymizer, which the Runtime Image rejects (they pull spaCy plus a language model downloaded at first use, and the sandbox has no network) - so the detection actually available is the model's own reading plus the format validators phonenumbers and python-stdnum, which are installed. That gap makes the NFR-001 wording discipline more load-bearing, not less.

rejected.reason: README states 'MIT license, based on Anthropic's official skills'. Its docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx dirs are Anthropic source-available content whose terms forbid derivative works and redistribution, so the MIT relicense has no basis. Also needs pandoc, poppler-utils, tesseract-ocr, qpdf, libreoffice, and resolves dependencies at runtime via uv + PEP 723.

INDEX.md states 100 of 166 skills come from Anthropic sources (Financial Services Plugins 51, Knowledge Work Plugins 41, Anthropic Official 8). Blanket MIT relicense has no basis. The 39 self-built skills may be legitimately MIT but each needs individual provenance confirmation - conditional candidate, not counted.

All 11 skills are built on live SERP research; write-content and improve-content both begin by Googling the topic and reading the top 5 results, improve-content also fetches the target URL. Conflicts with ADR-005 egress default-deny.

Needs the npm package pptxgenjs. PDM-004 whitelists Python packages only and the Runtime Image preinstalls no third-party npm packages; runtime npm install is forbidden. Re-review if a Node package whitelist is ever opened.
Requires the Typst CLI on PATH, plus optional babel. Not in the Runtime Image.
A pnpm monorepo application (cli/next/e2e), no SKILL.md and no skills/ directory. Not an Agent Skills package.

The skill dir contains only SKILL.md with no LICENSE.txt, and the repo root has no inheritable license file (metadata license: null). Re-checked 2026-08-15, unchanged since M0. External discovery tier only.
Non-standard license needing human interpretation; also requires a LaTeX toolchain.

discovery_only.note: Used as a discovery channel only, per PDM-002. Its documents section points entirely back at anthropics/skills and its writing section holds only brand-guidelines, internal-comms, one 0-star entry and a 'community needed' placeholder - independent confirmation that OSI supply for documents and writing is genuinely thin.
Discovery only. M0 established that over half its links point at officialskills.sh rather than source repos, so backtracking costs an extra manual lookup per entry.
